card.description: Why do users hesitate even after signing up?
QuickWins: They’re unsure what to do next.

card.heading: Too Many Decisions
card.description: Why does a product feel “heavy” or tiring to use?
QuickWins: Too many decisions at once.

card.heading: Features Without Priority
card.description: Why don’t features translate into usage?
QuickWins: They solve internal ideas, not user priorities.

card.heading: Demo vs. Daily Use Gap
card.description: Why do demos go well but adoption stalls?
QuickWins: Real usage isn’t a demo.
Products optimized for presentations often break in daily workflows.

card.heading: Silent Churn
card.description: Why do users churn without complaining?
QuickWins: Confusion doesn’t trigger feedback; it triggers exits.
People leave quietly when effort outweighs value.
